pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: The Spirit Vein Core is a concentrated node of spiritual energy hidden within a Spirit Stone vein. As energy accumulates over time, certain portions of the ore may crystallize into these rare cores. Not every vein contains one, but a sufficiently rich deposit may conceal several.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Generated within Spirit Stone veins. Each placed ore block has a 1-in-50 chance of becoming a Spirit Vein Core.
